name: LIFE Nature and Biodiversity: Standard Action Projects

administered_by.name: European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA)

summary: Annual EU call for nature conservation and restoration projects that help implement the Birds and Habitats Directives, manage the Natura 2000 network and protect species and habitats, open to public and private bodies established in the EU and LIFE-associated countries.

geography.label: EU Member States (including overseas countries and territories), listed EEA countries and countries associated to the LIFE Programme

reporting: Projects report outputs and impacts against the LIFE Project Indicators; longer projects may also submit progress reports, and a final report (with GIS data where relevant) closes the grant.

pool.quote: The estimated available call budget is EUR 173 500 000.

administered_by.quote: The European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA) presented the LIFE 2026 Calls for proposals during the EU LIFE 2026 info days.

applicant_types.quote: In order to be eligible, the applicants (beneficiaries and affiliated entities) must: - be legal entities (public or private bodies)

geography.quote: EU Member States (including overseas countries and territories (OCTs)) - non-EU countries: - listed EEA countries and countries associated to the LIFE Programme

access.quote: Proposals can only be submitted electronically through the Funding & Tenders portal.

window.quote: On 21 April, the European Commission launched the LIFE Programme Calls for proposals 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: The costs will be reimbursed at the funding rate fixed in the Grant Agreement (maximum 60%).

reporting.quote: All LIFE proposals will have to report on their expected outputs and impacts taking into account the LIFE Project Indicators (LPIs).
